pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.html:
Shipping Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-20.

This policy describes how orders are handled after checkout. Actual carrier times depend on destination and order availability; estimated delivery times are provided at checkout.

Order Processing

We process orders within 2 business days after payment. Orders placed on weekends or holidays are processed the next business day.

Shipping Destinations

We currently ship to the United States only. Cross-border shipping is not available from this store.

Shipping Rates

Standard shipping: US flat rate $4.99; free standard shipping on orders over $35.

Estimated Delivery

US standard delivery typically arrives in 5–8 business days after processing. Carrier timing may vary; the estimated delivery window is shown at checkout.

Order Tracking

A tracking number is emailed to you once your order ships.

Address Issues

It is the customer's responsibility to provide a correct shipping address. Re-routing or address correction after dispatch may incur additional carrier charges.

Customs and Duties

Because this store ships to the United States only, cross-border customs and duties do not apply to current orders.

Contact

Shipping questions: 1744059451@qq.com

pages.title: Return & Refund Policy
pages.html:
Return & Refund Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-20.

Return Eligibility

You may request a return within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.

Non-Returnable Items

Opened hygiene-related items cannot be returned.

How to Request a Return

Contact 1744059451@qq.com with your order number. We will send return instructions by email.

Return Shipping Costs

Unless the item arrives damaged or defective, return shipping costs are paid by the customer.

Refunds

Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the returned item. Original shipping charges are not refundable.

Exchanges

Exchanges are handled case by case. Contact 1744059451@qq.com with your order number to check availability, any price difference, and return-shipping responsibility before a replacement is arranged.

Damaged or Defective Items

If an item arrives damaged or defective, contact us with photos within 30 days of delivery. We will arrange a replacement or refund according to eligibility.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.html:
Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-11-20.

What We Collect

  • Contact and order information: name, email address, shipping address, and order details
  • Challenge participation: email signup, chosen platform, and daily task interaction
  • Usage data: email opens and store browsing behavior

How We Use Information

  • Process orders and provide customer support
  • Send the 7-Day Shooting Challenge sequence and marketing emails, where you have consented
  • Improve the store experience and product assortment

Data Retention

Order records are kept for 24 months. Marketing consent remains active until 30 days after you unsubscribe; after that, the associated email is removed from marketing lists.

Email Marketing

Marketing emails are sent only with your consent. Each email includes an unsubscribe option.

Sharing Information

We do not sell personal data. Information is shared with service providers (payment, shipping, email) only as needed to operate the store.

Cookies and Pixels

The store uses necessary cookies to operate checkout and remember your preferences. Non-essential cookies can be declined through your browser or store consent settings where available.

Security

We apply reasonable measures to protect personal data; no method of transmission over the internet is fully secure.

Your Rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, and may withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email 1744059451@qq.com.

Children

The store is not directed to children under 13. If you are under 13, do not place an order or submit personal data.

Contact

Privacy questions: 1744059451@qq.com

Challenge Participation

Promo Codes

Discount codes such as NEWCREATOR10 and STARTERKIT follow the rules listed at checkout: eligibility, one-use limits, stacking restrictions, excluded items, and validity dates. A code cannot be applied after an order is placed.

If you have an issue with an order or product, contact us at 1744059451@qq.com first. We will work with you by email to try to resolve the matter directly.

pages.title: 7-Day Shooting Challenge
pages.html:
7-Day Shooting Challenge

Seven short daily tasks. One small step each day to plan, film, and publish your first short video. Sign up with your email to receive daily prompts and ShotStarter template suggestions.

Rules

  • Sign up with a valid email; one short challenge email arrives each day for seven days.
  • Complete one task per day. You may adapt tasks to your product and style.
  • Use ShotStarter drafts as starting points — review and edit before posting.
  • The challenge is free to join; no purchase is required.
  • Participation does not guarantee followers, sales, or any platform result.

Daily Tasks

Day 1 — Pick your topic and selling point. Write down your product or topic and the one point you want viewers to remember. Use ShotStarter to set your platform and product type.

Day 2 — Plan your 15-second script. Generate a draft script with ShotStarter; edit the opening line so it sounds like you.

Day 3 — Set up your shot. Choose a flat surface or tripod/stand position; clean your lens; frame your first shot.

Day 4 — Shoot four storyboard clips. Follow the four-shot storyboard: opening hook, product/topic close-up, middle demonstration, closing line. Record each clip.

Day 5 — Assemble your cut. Trim clips to a 15-second pace; add simple captions; check lighting and focus.

Day 6 — Write the publish caption. Use the ShotStarter caption draft; add your own voice, relevant hashtags, and a clear call to action.

Day 7 — Publish and review. Post your first short video, note what worked, and plan your next clip.

Thank-You Message

You're in. Day 1 is below — start shooting. Remember: your first shot starts here.
